A quick C++ standard container overview

by Jens Weller

From the article:

The last entry looked at heap allocations, but one important part about heap allocations was missing: hidden allocations. Often you don't allocate directly, but a used class does. The C++ containers and string classes are the perfect example of this. Allocations for containers in the standard are done via allocators, which usually means heap allocations. These can be categorized as node based, chunk based and continuous memory containers...
